summary: Held the entire episode. Price never went negative after t=1m (-3.5pts min); it ran to a +31.25pt peak around t=12m, then chopped/decayed back down but stayed in a +12 to +25pt band through the end of the window, always well clear of breakeven. There was no wrong-direction signature: no sustained close below zero, no giveback approaching 100% of the full-trade amplitude, and the against-fires (KMDR/HA/PROPP/CLIMAX) were frequent but never coincided with price actually breaking into losing territory. Next time I'd watch for giveback computed against the full-trade high-water mark (not just the most recent small leg) crossing toward 100% while price approaches or crosses zero -- that combination, not isolated indicator fires, is what would mark a genuine reversal worth bailing on.
